components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Aqua jelly pill for the main action on a screen.
components.css: .ds-btn { position: relative; isolation: isolate; overflow: hidden; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; height: 40px; padding: 0 18px; border-radius: 999px; font: 600 13px/1 Unbounded, system-ui, sans-serif; color: #fff; text-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.38); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), filter 160ms; } .ds-btn::before { content: ''; position: absolute; z-index: -1; inset: 2px 8px auto; height: 40%; border-radius: 999px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,.55), rgba(255,255,255,.04)); } .ds-btn-aqua { border: 1px solid #044a75; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #8adfff 0%, #0a7bbd 52%, #075a8e 100%); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.65), inset 0 -4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.12), 0 8px 16px -8px rgba(10,123,189,.5); } .ds-btn:hover { filter: brightness(1.06) saturate(1.06); transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px #ff2ad2; }

components.name: Pink Button
components.description: Pink jelly pill for creative actions (add text, add sticker).
components.css: .ds-btn-pink { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 40px; padding: 0 18px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid #6e0656; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ff9eea 0%, #d4179f 52%, #990a76 100%); color: #fff; font: 600 13px/1 Unbounded, system-ui, sans-serif; text-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.38); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.65), 0 8px 16px -8px rgba(255,42,210,.5); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn-pink:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); filter: brightness(1.06); } .ds-btn-pink:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px #ff2ad2; }

components.name: Chrome Button
components.css: .ds-btn-chrome { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 40px; padding: 0 18px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid #6f8197; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ffffff 0%, #e3eaf2 52%, #a9b8c9 100%); color: #0b1626; font: 600 13px/1 Unbounded, system-ui, sans-serif; text-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.8); box-shadow: inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.65), 0 8px 16px -8px rgba(70,100,140,.4); cursor: pointer; } .ds-btn-chrome:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); } .ds-btn-chrome:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px #fff, 0 0 0 4px #ff2ad2; }

components.name: Program Window
components.description: The signature container: glossy title bar with a filename, jelly lights, body, status bar.
components.html:
presets.exe
Window body
1000 × 1500 px
components.css: .ds-window { width: 280px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid rgba(40,96,148,.5); border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 22px 44px -22px rgba(6,58,108,.5), 0 4px 14px -6px rgba(6,58,108,.28), inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.9); font-family: Chivo, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-window-bar { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; height: 30px; padding: 0 8px 0 10px; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ecfcff 0%, #b3eeff 45%, #74d8fa 50%, #4fc7f2 100%); color: #03233a; font: 600 11.5px Unbounded, system-ui, sans-serif; text-shadow: 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,.75); } .ds-window-bar span { flex: 1; } .ds-window-bar i { width: 11px; height: 11px; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.28); background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ffd2f5, #ff2ad2); } .ds-window-bar i:nth-of-type(2) { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fff2b8, #ffb400); } .ds-window-bar i:nth-of-type(3) { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #dcffd0, #2fcf45); } .ds-window-body { padding: 14px; color: #0a1424; } .ds-window-status { padding: 4px 12px; border-top: 1px solid #c5d4e3; background: #f1f7fc; color: #536479; font: 500 12px 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Inset field with a pink focus glow.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 260px; height: 44px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 10px; border: 1.5px solid #9bb0c6; background: #f1f7fc; color: #0a1424; font: 400 16px Chivo, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: inset 0 2px 4px rgba(10,40,80,.06); transition: border-color 140ms, box-shadow 140ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #536479; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #ff2ad2; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(255,42,210,.2); }

components.name: Choice Chip
components.description: Text style / font picker; selected becomes pink jelly.
components.css: .ds-chip { height: 32px; padding: 0 10px; margin-right: 6px; border-radius: 9px; border: 1px solid #9bb0c6; background: #f1f7fc; color: #0a1424; font: 700 12px Chivo, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color: #ff2ad2; } .ds-chip-on { border-color: #990a76; background: linear-gradient(180deg, #ff9eea, #d4179f 55%, #990a76); color: #fff; text-shadow: 0 1px 1px rgba(0,0,0,.25); }

components.name: Segmented Tabs
components.description: Pill track with a glossy active segment (filter groups, mobile editor tabs).
components.css: .ds-seg { display: inline-flex; gap: 2px; padding: 3px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid #c5d4e3; background: #e4eef7; } .ds-seg button { height: 30px; padding: 0 12px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: transparent; color: #33445c; font: 800 12.5px Chivo, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-seg button[aria-selected='true'] { background: linear-gradient(180deg, #8adfff, #0a7bbd 52%, #075a8e); color: #fff; text-shadow: 0 1px 1px rgba(0,0,0,.25); }

narrative.overview: Y2KEDIT looks like a desktop from the Frutiger Aero years: pale aqua sky, glossy jelly buttons, and little program windows titled like files (presets.exe, filters.dll, stickers.zip). The edit is the one bright, saturated thing on screen; everything around it is glass, chrome and sky. In dark mode the same desktop goes cyber at night: near-black ground, magenta-to-maroon title bars and pink glow. The editor is a working tool first. The world lends it type, palette, window chrome and one signature move (preset tiles render your own photo); the controls themselves are ordinary sliders, tabs and buttons.
keyCharacteristics: Program windows with glossy title bars and filename titles frame every panel, dialog and card.
Jelly pill buttons: aqua for the main action, pink for creative actions, chrome for neutral ones.
Cyber pink marks selection and "this is active" everywhere.
Unbounded's wide black weight for display; Chivo for reading; IBM Plex Mono only for numbers.
Light follows the system setting; dark is a full theme, not an inversion.

rules.name: The One Bright Thing Rule
rules.body: The photo on the stage is the most saturated object on screen. Interface chrome stays glassy and pale so it never competes with the edit.

rules.name: The Pink Means Picked Rule
rules.body: Cyber pink is reserved for selection, active state and focus. Don't use it as decoration in working screens.

rules.name: The Numbers-Only Mono Rule
rules.body: Monospace appears only where the content is a measurement or a key: slider values, pixel sizes, share URLs, kbd. Never as a "techy" costume for labels.

rules.name: The Soft Glass Rule
rules.body: Shadows always have offset and blur. No zero-blur offset shadows; this world is glass, not neobrutalism.

dos: Do put every panel, dialog and card in a program window with a filename title (share.exe, readme.txt).
Do keep white labels only on the deepened jelly colours (#0a7bbd, #d4179f), so they pass 4.5:1.
Do draw icons from Lucide or as authored SVG; stickers are authored SVG or PNG assets.
Do keep the photo the most saturated thing on the editor screen.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion: bubbles, marquee and the scan-in reel all settle.
donts: Don't use kicker or eyebrow labels above headings, or numbered section labels.
Don't use emoji or Unicode glyphs as icons; ★ is only a typographic separator or list marker.
Don't set gradient text in the interface. The one sanctioned use is the owner-pinned chrome lettering (a single hero word, and the editor's own text-overlay styles).
Don't use monospace for labels or prose.
